transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. Well... it's a little hard to talk about. I guess what finally scared me into coming in is... lately, after I eat too much, I've been... making myself throw up. In the bathroom. I just don't want to gain weight, and... well, it's gotten to the point where it isn't just a one-time mistake anymore.
How often have you been making yourself throw up after eating?

Um... I don't keep an exact count. But... I suppose for at least the past several months, it's been... most weeks. I'll have one of those... secret eating spells, and then... I go make myself sick afterward. I just... I can't really call it occasional anymore.
Can you describe what you mean by a 'secret eating spell'?

Well... it's just... when I'm alone. Like, if I come home after a late shift at the store, or... maybe after a bridge night. I just... I eat. 

A lot at once. I might have some leftover casserole... and then cookies I baked, crackers, ice cream... just all in one sitting. It's... well, it's much more food than I'd ever put on a plate if anyone else was looking.
Do you feel like you're in control of how much you're eating during those secret eating spells?

Um... no. Not really. It's... well, once I start, it just sort of feels like I'm on automatic. I'll be standing there in the kitchen, thinking... I really should stop before my husband notices anything is missing, but... I just keep reaching for one more thing anyway. I can't seem to stop myself.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Well... yes. I suppose I am. 

It's just... if my skirt feels a bit tight when I'm getting dressed for church, or... if I happen to catch my side view in one of the mirrors at the store... it just... it really bothers me. It can ruin my whole day, honestly. I just get this feeling that... that everyone is looking and can tell I've let myself go.
How often do you have these secret eating spells where you feel like you're eating automatically?

Um... well... I suppose for at least the past several months, it's... it's been happening most weeks. I can't honestly call it just an occasional thing anymore. And... well... after I have one of those spells, I... I usually go and make myself sick.
Have you ever had one of these secret eating spells where you felt like you were eating automatically, but you didn't make yourself throw up afterward?
Um... no. I don't think so. I... I pretty much always do.

Have you ever had one of those secret eating spells where you felt like you were eating automatically and didn't make yourself throw up afterward, but still felt guilty or upset about how much you ate?
No, I... I don't think so. Like I said, I... I always make myself sick after. I can't really think of a time I didn't.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time, felt like you couldn't stop, and then didn't make yourself throw up afterward?
No... I mean, it's like I just said. I... I always make myself sick. I don't really... I don't have times where I just keep it down.
Have you ever felt like you were eating a lot and couldn't stop, without making yourself throw up afterward?
I... no. It's... it's always the same. I just... I don't do that.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time and felt like you couldn't stop, without then making yourself throw up?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said... I always get rid of it. I don't have times where I don't.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time and felt like you couldn't stop, without doing anything to try to get rid of the food afterward?
I... look, you keep asking the same thing. No. I don't. I just... I always get rid of it. That's just how it is.
Have you ever used laxatives or diuretics after one of your secret eating spells?
No, I... I don't use those. Just... what I told you before.
Have you ever exercised excessively to try to burn off calories after one of your secret eating spells?
No. I... I don't really exercise. I'm on my feet all day at the store, so... no. I just do what I told you.
Have you ever fasted for a day or more after one of your secret eating spells?
No. I don't really do that either. I just... I eat, and then I throw up. That's all.
Have you ever used any other methods to try to compensate for eating too much, besides making yourself throw up?
No. I don't do anything else. Just... what I already said. There's nothing else.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time and felt like you couldn't stop, without then making yourself throw up or doing anything else to try to get rid of the food?
No. I... no. If I eat like that, I always... I always throw up. I don't ever just... let it sit there.
Have you ever felt like you were eating and couldn't stop, even when you hadn't eaten a lot of food?
No... not really. I mean, if I haven't eaten much, I don't get that... that feeling. It's only when I eat a lot.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time, felt like you couldn't stop, and then didn't do anything to try to get rid of the food?
No. I just told you that. I always... I always get rid of it. I don't just leave it there.
